query_analysis.original_query: Could you help me design a monitoring system to predict early fouling in demisters for separators handling heavy hydrocarbon condensates. What sensors and control strategies would you recommend?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a monitoring system for early detection of fouling in demisters used in heavy hydrocarbon condensate separation, including sensor selection and control strategy recommendations.

selected_agents.role: Monitoring system design and control strategy development

communication_strategy.information_flow: Sensor data analysis and control loop design
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative feedback on fouling detection and control effectiveness

clarification_questions: What are the typical operating conditions (temperature, pressure, flow rate) of the separator?
What is the composition of the heavy hydrocarbon condensate?
Are there any existing sensors or monitoring systems in place?
